rule_or_pattern: Drop maths-bearing lines: label contains any of [=×<>|∈] or ',...,' OR a capital letter followed by ';' (subscript j read as ';', e.g. 'Χ;', 'W;') OR a standalone single-letter token other than ο/η/ή/Ο/Η/Ή, regex (?<![\w'])(?![οηήΟΗΉ](?![\w']))[A-Za-zΑ-Ωα-ωά-ώ](?![\w']) . Keep the plain prose and the R-code lines.
notes: Small LaTeX actuarial-credibility thesis (title metadata about 5G does not match). Plain Greek prose with Latin names reads correctly (2-5, 9-10, 12-13, 15-18, 23-25, 31-34), as do the R-code lines 26/35. Inline maths is misread: bold X_j / W_j become 'Χ;' / 'W;' (8, 11, 14, 29, 30), Θ_K → Θκ (6), p → ρ (28), μ_t(Θ_j) → 'με (Θ;)' (36), and subscript strings are flattened (14, 20).
